title: fht/lp-wgs pipeline parameters
description: An open-source shallow whole genome sequence analysis pipeline

input_output_options.title: Input/output options
input_output_options.description: Define where the pipeline should find input data and save output data.

input.description: Path to comma-separated file containing information about the samples in the experiment.
input.help_text: You will need to create a design file with information about the samples in your experiment before running the pipeline. Use this parameter to specify its location. It has to be a comma-separated file with 3 columns, and a header row.

outdir.description: The output directory where the results will be saved. You have to use absolute paths to storage on Cloud infrastructure.

workflow_options.title: Workflow options
workflow_options.description: Control the overall pipeline route and analysis tools.

step.description: The pipeline can start from unaligned fastqs or from mapped bam file
step.help_text: paths to fastqs or bam files are supplied in the input.csv file

tech.description: Both illumina short reads and nanopore long reads can be processed by this pipeline

tools.description: Comma-separated list of downstream calling tools to run.

sequencing_options.title: Sequencing metadata options
sequencing_options.description: Define metadata used when constructing read groups.

seq_center.description: This is added to the bam metadata to give information about where the sequencing was performed

seq_platform.description: The sequencing platform information is useful for upload to sequence archives

library.description: LB = {SM}.{library-specific identifier}(Important To identify PCR duplicates in MarkDuplicates step. Ignore in PCR free libraries)

fastp_adapter_fasta.description: Optional adapter FASTA passed to fastp with --adapter_fasta.

call_gc.description: Optional call gc on reference fasta for input into hmm readcounter

filter_bam.description: for cfDNA the theory is that cfDNA tends to be between 90 to 150 bp, this option allows fragments to be filtered to that size

ploidy.description: Comma-separated ploidy values passed to ACE and ASCAT, for example 2 or 2,3,4.

normal.description: optional path to normal bam for ichor

low_reads.description: Enable settings intended for extremely low read counts.

ascat_pcf_gamma.description: Penalty passed to copynumber::pcf for ASCAT low-pass segmentation.

ichor_purity_manual.description: option to supply purity manually to ichor e.g. c(0.95,0.99,0.995,0.999)

ichor_genome_build.description: Genome-build label passed to ichorCNA. Derived from the genome configuration when unset.

ichor_genome_style.description: Chromosome naming style passed to ichorCNA. Derived from the genome configuration when unset.

medicc_source.description: Copy-number caller output used to prepare MEDICC2 input.

reference_genome_options.title: Reference genome options
reference_genome_options.description: Select a configured genome or provide individual reference resources.

genome.description: Name of the reference genome configuration to use.

igenomes_ignore.description: Ignore reference paths supplied by the nf-core iGenomes configuration.

igenomes_base.description: Base directory containing iGenomes reference files.

save_reference.description: Save generated reference index files in the output directory.

fasta.description: Reference genome FASTA file. Overrides the FASTA selected through --genome.

fasta_fai.description: FASTA index file. Overrides the index selected through --genome.

dict.description: Sequence dictionary for the reference genome.

bwa.description: Directory containing the BWA reference index.

map_wig.description: Directory containing chromosome-specific mappability WIG files.

mosdepth_bed.description: BED file defining regions used for mosdepth coverage calculation.

medicc_arms.description: File defining chromosome arms for MEDICC2.

medicc_genes.description: Gene annotation file used for MEDICC2 input preparation.

reporting_options.title: Reporting options
reporting_options.description: Configure MultiQC and Nextflow execution reports.

multiqc_config.description: Custom configuration file passed to MultiQC.

multiqc_title.description: Custom title for the MultiQC report.

multiqc_logo.description: Custom logo displayed in the MultiQC report.

multiqc_methods_description.description: Custom methods-description template included in the MultiQC report.

tracedir.description: Directory in which Nextflow execution reports are written.

publish_dir_mode.description: Method used to publish pipeline results to the output directory.

trace_timestamp.description: Timestamp used to name Nextflow trace, report, timeline and DAG files.

email.description: Email address to receive the pipeline completion summary.

email_on_fail.description: Email address to notify only when the pipeline fails.

plaintext_email.description: Send plain-text email rather than HTML email.

hook_url.description: Webhook URL to notify when the pipeline finishes.

max_multiqc_email_size.description: Maximum size of the MultiQC report that may be attached to a notification email.

generic_options.title: Generic options
generic_options.description: Less common options for the pipeline, typically set in a config file.
generic_options.help_text:
These options are common to all nf-core pipelines and allow you to customise some of the core preferences for how the pipeline runs.

Typically these options would be set in a Nextflow config file loaded for all pipeline runs, such as `~/.nextflow/config`.

help_full.description: Display the complete help text and exit.

show_hidden.description: Display hidden parameters in the help output.

monochrome_logs.description: Do not use coloured log outputs.

validate_params.description: Boolean whether to validate parameters against the schema at runtime
